name: Somer
source:
"I hope this song will lift everyone's spirits!"

An ordinary young man who loves to sing and hopes to heal hearts with his voice.
Though constantly plagued by a bizarre string of bad luck, he remains optimistic and kind, pursuing his dream of becoming a singer.
Facing unexpected challenges, he accepts help from Psion and becomes his assistant, leading to a unique and inescapable close-quarters cohabitation.

Zodiac: Sagittarius
Animal Aspect: None
Hobby: Sewing Handicrafts

[From [url=https://www.godly-love.com/en/]website[/url]]
